name: Visit the nodes
description: Tap the nodes of a generated graph in the order BFS or DFS visits them. Graded by the longest correct prefix; the real traversal animates afterwards.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Optional line shown under the prompt (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: size
fields.description: Number of nodes, 6 to 9. Empty: random each review.
